title: The Newsletter WordPress plugin before 9.4.0 does not keep a subscriber's secret key out of the redirect it returns…
description: The Newsletter WordPress plugin versions before 9.4.0 expose a subscriber's secret key in the redirect URL returned after a subscription request when double opt-in is enabled. This vulnerability allows unauthenticated attackers to confirm a subscription for any email address without needing access to that email's mailbox. Additionally, if the email address already has an unconfirmed subscription, attackers can reset that subscription record with their own details.
